newsitem.title: UK: UK longer leading index falls 0.5% in Jan.
newsitem.headline: UK longer leading index falls 0.5% in Jan.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics released the following indices on economic activity in Britain:

NOTES - longer leader signals turning points in the economy some 13 months in advance, shorter leading index indicates turning points about five months in advance, coincident index moves in line with business cycle, lagging index shows turning points about 12 months after it happened.
The ONS said this is the final first release for cyclical indicators of the UK economy. The ONS will cease to compile and publish the indicators because of the need to find resources
to develop work for the changes to the national accounts which will take place in 1998.
